summary: Leg day, so lunch and dinner lean carb-heavy to fuel the session. Chicken is the protein backbone all day (turkey at breakfast, Citrus Garlic Chicken + extra chicken breast at lunch, Mary's Black Pepper Chicken + extra chicken breast at dinner) with the Strawberry Mango Tajin Smoothie (has added protein powder) standing in for the usual wellness-bar protein smoothie since no cottage cheese smoothie is on today's menu.

meals.name: Uber Breakfast
meals.note: Oatmeal bowl with fruit, toast, turkey and Greek yogurt for steady protein and carbs before the day.

meals.name: Uber HQ Lunch
meals.note: Citrus Garlic Chicken plate with extra chicken breast, rice and beans for a carb-forward leg-day lunch.

meals.name: Uber Pre-workout
meals.note: Low-fat, carb-forward smoothie plus half a bagel and yogurt, eaten before the leg session.

meals.name: Uber Post-workout / Dinner
meals.note: Mary's Black Pepper Chicken with extra chicken breast, rice, beans and corn to refuel after legs.
